title: System Design Case Studies
intro: System design case studies for Rails engineers should be solved with Rails tooling in mind — not generic distributed systems that could be any stack. A URL shortener uses PostgreSQL for the mapping and Redis for hot lookups. A news feed at scale uses Sidekiq for fan-out and Redis sorted sets for the feed timeline. A chat system uses ActionCable over Redis pub/sub. A notification service uses Sidekiq with multiple queues and priority routing to APNs, FCM, and SendGrid. This page walks through five case studies with capacity numbers (mandatory — 'lots of users' fails the depth check), Rails-specific implementation decisions, and the trade-offs at each architectural inflection point — the same structure an interviewer at a Rails shop expects to hear.
